title: alert first word is type
rule: First word is the type: Informative / Warning / Success / Error / Emergency (or a more precise first word such as “Announcement”). Heading ≤1 line. Extra detail in the body, not a second heading line. Users must not rely on colour or icon alone.
pass_when: Heading starts with the type (or a more precise first word), stays on one line, and meaning is not colour/icon-only.
fail_when: Type is only an icon/colour; heading wraps to a second line of detail.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
